an5.6:1.1: na tāva bhikkhave akusalassa samāpatti hoti yāva saddhā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an5.6:1.2: yato ca kho bhikkhave saddhā antarahitā hoti assaddhiyaṃ pariyuddhāya tiṭṭhati
an5.6:2.1: na tāva bhikkhave akusalassa samāpatti hoti yāva hirī paccupaṭṭhitā hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an5.6:2.2: yato ca kho bhikkhave hirī antarahitā hoti ahirikaṃ pariyuddhāya tiṭṭhati
an5.6:3.1: na tāva bhikkhave akusalassa samāpatti hoti yāva ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an5.6:3.2: yato ca kho bhikkhave ottappaṃ antarahitaṃ hoti anottappaṃ pariyuddhāya tiṭṭhati
an5.6:4.1: na tāva bhikkhave akusalassa samāpatti hoti yāva viriyaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an5.6:4.2: yato ca kho bhikkhave viriyaṃ antarahitaṃ hoti kosajjaṃ pariyuddhāya tiṭṭhati
an5.6:5.1: na tāva bhikkhave akusalassa samāpatti hoti yāva paññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an5.6:5.2: yato ca kho bhikkhave paññā antarahitā hoti duppaññā pariyuddhāya tiṭṭhati
